title: Repair isolated original-field omission negatives
scope: lane only; does not close task 7, mark plan checkboxes, or claim full conformance
result: Each of the 28 original-field omission checks now starts from the complete valid row, including its pricing directive, removes only the intended original field, requires the issue path category.0.original.field with code invalid_type and message Required, and requires the same candidate to parse after that field is restored.

regressions.originalId: schema stops requiring the original identity key
regressions.originalWallet: schema stops requiring the original wallet
regressions.originalUnits: schema stops requiring the positive original quantity
regressions.originalEth: schema stops requiring the ETH component
regressions.originalDtf: schema stops requiring the DTF component
regressions.source: schema stops requiring the fixed source address
regressions.evidenceId: schema stops requiring the evidence binding

risks: weighted-sy.test.ts is 204 non-blank, non-comment lines, inside the 200-250 warning band. It was not split: the certificate tests are witness-adjacent and this lane cannot reshuffle them. The next edit that adds lines should split those tests out.
The production schema was not mutated. It is outside this lane. The pre-fix reconstruction shows a boolean failure stays green when the field is restored and pricing is absent.
Two /tmp/dtf-prepare-test directories with execution checkpoints were left untouched. This lane's fixture does not write those files.
Full operator suite, Forge, and full typecheck were not run, as instructed while sibling lanes are editing.
assumptions: The existing preparation fixture is the valid priced row for all four categories.
Zod 3.25 reports a missing required key as invalid_type / Required at the omitted path. The repaired assertion pins that observed issue.
concurrentChanges: Preserved the pre-existing bookId edits in the four owned tests and all unrelated dirty work. Did not edit census implementation, witness-pin files, shared fixtures, or production code.
limits: This claim covers the F2-02 omission lane only. It does not replace task 7, authorize implementation beyond these tests, or mark a plan checkbox.
